originalRequirements.text: Recover and implement the earlier work-item and GitHub Issues architecture with a local-only mode, a GitHub-backed mode, and an optimized governed hybrid mode.
Keep work-item execution and verification local and offline-capable; make any remote publishing or intake an explicit project and item decision that avoids leaking private project information.
Make GitHub Issue adoption, publication, updates, identity recovery, and closing correct under retries, conflicts, concurrent worktrees, and partial network failures.
Close remote issues only after real local verified promotion evidence, while preserving the local result when remote synchronization fails.
Integrate the selected tracking mode with existing work-item schema, routing, skills, installation, and multi-host behavior without creating a second execution authority.
Improve plan validation so the plan proves that its tests and observations are necessary, meaningful, and independent of the implementation rather than merely numerous or structurally linked.
Resolve findings from two real independent Opus and Grok plan reviews and prepare the complete governed plan contract before implementation.

facts.owner_decisions: Local-only is default; github-backed publishes adopted WI-GH-N only; hybrid may publish local and adopted WIs; all public payloads are explicit and curated. close_trigger is manual by default or verify-promotion. The shared identity map is Git-common-dir/svc-issue-tracker/map.json, while repo config has no private terms. Remote closure requires validated durable verify-promotion note bound to a reachable commit. Review findings are REVISE, so no implementation authority has yet been granted.
